title: An ambient integer multiplicity cycle carried by a plane over a connected planar domain has constant multiplicity there
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n, let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C), and let R be an integer multiplicity representation of C in ℝ^P (R : IMRep ℝ^P n with R.Represents C), with mass measure μ := R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞R.carrier).withDensity(R.mult), Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let V ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim Q = n (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n) such that V ∩ Q is connected and spt C ∩ V ⊆ Q. Then there is c ∈ ℕ with μ(E) = c·Hⁿ(E ∩ Q) for every Borel set E ⊆ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen V → BoundaryVanishes C → R.Represents C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → IsConnected (V ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → C.support ∩ V ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ V → R.measure E = (c : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (E ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P)))
